summary: Catron County crow's-nest site on the Gila National Forest, listed as gone by the FFLA; no build, staffing or site history found in the sources read.

facts.status_note: The FFLA lists the site as gone; no source read says what, if anything, remains

evidence.supports: Catron County; Crows Nest type; Gone; coordinates 33.75973 -108.88547
evidence.quote: Highland Park Catron 33.75973 -108.88547 Crows Nest Gone

evidence.supports: listed under the Gila National Forest

notes_for_editor: Very thin record. Support is the FFLA New Mexico list entry (Crows Nest, Gone, coordinates) and a Forest Lookouts page that gives only the name and the Gila National Forest. The FFLA type 'Crows Nest' is stored in the record as 'platform', the same mapping the record uses for Luera Peak, so no correction is proposed. Searches found no build date, staffing or fate. A Facebook group post asking for the lookout's history appeared in search, but its text could not be read (login wall), so it is not cited. The next useful step is a Gila National Forest lookout history or a records request.
